bullets.text: Auto drivers staged a protest in Periyapalayam against the TVK government, and the office should monitor local unrest in Thiruvallur district.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is visiting Chennai with a five-tier security deployment of 22000 police personnel, and the office must oversee security arrangements.
The public detained police officers in Thiruvallur causing high tension, and the office should review local police-public relations and address community grievances.
Minister Rajeev inaugurated the Online Musical Instruments Management and Monitoring System help desk in Chennai, and the portfolio team should track digital service rollouts.
Minister Rajkumar celebrated the TVK by-election victories in Melmaruvathur, and the office should note the political developments regarding party performance.
CMDA suspended 50 infrastructure projects worth 1340.3 crore rupees due to severe financial constraints, and the constituency team should review stalled urban works.
Passengers reported that trains pass through Adambakkam MRTS station without stopping due to engineering issues, and the office should coordinate with Southern Railway for a fix.
Collector Kavitha announced a special education loan camp for students in Thiruvallur district, and the district team should monitor the camp's implementation and student turnout.
Paddy transplanting operations across 110000 acres in Ponneri are advancing swiftly with migrant workers from West Bengal and Assam, and the office should track agricultural labor trends.
MeitY directed social media platforms to label misleading content and act against unlawful protest material, and the portfolio team should monitor compliance across digital channels.
India's AI data centre expansion is facing growing local opposition and protests over water, power, and environmental concerns, and the ministry should review sustainable infrastructure policies.
Maragatham Kumaravel secured a massive victory for TVK in the Madurantakam by-election, and the office should track shifting political dynamics in the region.
Extravagant victory celebrations erupted at the TVK party headquarters in Panaiyur as early trends showed leads in by-elections, and the office should monitor party activities.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Porur metro rail service, and the office should prepare for infrastructure launch collaborations.
IIT Hyderabad opened applications for its Applied AI Programme 2026, and the IT department should explore similar educational and skilling partnerships for Tamil Nadu.
